title: The Little Rainbow Who Found Her Colors
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A little rainbow whose colors are soft and gentle discovers that you are special just as you are, and your gentle light matters to the world.
long_description: Iris is a little rainbow whose colors are soft and gentle. She longs to be bright like all the others. When she helps a little girl feel calm, Iris discovers a wonderful secret: you are special just as you are, and your gentle light matters to the world. A gentle bedtime story about self-acceptance, kindness, and shining in your own way.
moral_lesson: You are special and beautiful exactly as you are — you don't need to be like everyone else.
